usedFor: ITM Platform manages projects, and “Create Task” adds a task with its details, type, priority and dates.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Task” in ITM Platform
bestTemplate.why: A message becomes a task in a project with priority and dates, so it is not forgotten.

watchOut: “Create Task” adds work to a project, so check that the step names the project it belongs to.
